consumers.role: Reads checked packages strictly, links dependency packages and lowers claims to Contract IR obligations.

facts.fact: The checked-package document type the producer writes and the reader admits.
The structural import view of an admitted dependency package.
The schedulability claim roots of a checked package, each with its claim occurrence.
The obligation identity of a schedulability claim occurrence.

consumers.role: Links a finite protocol from a checked protocol clause and analyzes it.

facts.fact: The protocol view of a clause: its roles, channels, queues, controls, compensations, run and finish nodes.
The causal relation derived from the clause's protocol nodes.
A channel's endpoints: its sending role, receiving role and message type.
The anchor of an await: the control or compensation template it follows.
The visibility of a choice: its owner and visible expressions.
The attempts maximum of a compensation.

consumers.role: Replays checked functions, operations and clauses and generates code from them.

facts.fact: The call site of a function, operation or clause of a compiled package.
The call site of an imported function: its declaring package and its function occurrence, from the same dependency lock.
The obligation identity of a function or operation site.
The closed-form schedulability verdict, settled after recomputing its evidence.

consumers.role: Runs a tick-based monitor plan on a target.

facts.fact: The monitor plan root for a selected unit.
The authenticated progress view and authority selections admitted from a request or event input.

consumers.role: Drives lifecycle requests and settles their run results.

facts.fact: The bounded strict reader of native-run-result/2 bytes.
The writer of a clause run result as native-run-result/2 bytes.
The typed run result, a clause record or a command error.

consumers.role: Binds typed observations to the subjects a checked package declares.

facts.fact: The subject kinds and relationship declarations taken from the checked package's domain declarations.
